findings.finding: H1 FY3/2027 was pre-released on TDnet on 2026-10-20 at 15:30 (operating revenue 2,999m, OP 1,041m, NI 727m). That implies a standalone Q2 (Jul-Sep) of revenue 1,216m / OP 302m / NI 199m, against Q1's 1,783m / 739m / 528m and last year's Q2 of 1,144m / 307m / 209m: a sharp sequential slowdown, flat year on year. The 10-27 短信 is the confirming document for numbers the market has held for a week.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 速報値 release took the reaction: 2026-10-20 close 1,794 to 2026-10-21 close 1,707 = -4.85%, then drift to 1,669 on 10-23. Confirming 短信 releases over the last 16 prints (computed from Yahoo daily closes) moved a median of about 1.2% absolute with no consistent sign. After big negative 速報 days the 短信 moved -0.29% (2024-07), -1.72% (2024-10) and +1.55% (2025-04).
findings.why_not_priced: It IS priced. Volume spiked to 71,900 shares on 10-21 (about 5x normal) and the stock fell 4.85%. Kabutan carried the headline the same day (非開示だった上期経常は2.1倍増益へ). The finding is filed at 0 because the release adds no new line: there is no forecast, the dividend is already set, and the numbers are already out.

baseline_tension: No tension. The positioning lean (+1.03, all from the -20.6% run-up) is a mild mean-reversion read. The pre-release already explains about 10% of that fall (1,900 on 10-19 to 1,669 on 10-23). Under rule 2 I looked for the strongest positive the release could carry: a buyback, a dividend change or a forecast. None is expected at this print, so the lean is left to the free control and not added.
